name: suggestion-menu
title: Suggestion Menu
description: The caret-anchored list an editor opens while you type a trigger (@, /, {{) — shared by TextEdit's slash and mention menus and TemplateEditor's placeholder picker, with rows that read exactly like ComboboxItem's.

meta.whenToUse: Installed automatically with TextEdit or TemplateEditor; import it directly when another editor that keeps focus needs a caret-anchored list of suggestions.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list that takes focus or hangs off a trigger element — that is Combobox, Command or DropdownMenu.
